editorial:
Imagine you are on a fun summer break with your best friends, paddling a canoe through a quiet lake. That is how things start for four 14-year-old girls who just want to hang out and have a good time. But the vibe shifts quickly when they realize they are not alone in the woods. What starts as a simple camping trip turns into a scary game of cat and mouse. You will feel for these girls as they try to figure out why someone is hunting them and how to get out of the wilderness alive.

What really works here is how the tension builds up. The acting feels real for kids their age, and the action scenes keep you on the edge of your seat. While some of the plot points are a bit predictable, the fast pace makes it an easy watch. If you love slashers with a young cast, you should definitely check this out. It looks great if you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but renting it on Apple TV is also a quick way to watch. For the real movie buffs, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: The girls discover that they are being hunted by a psycho killer who has a dark history with the lake. After a lot of fighting and running, the girls use their teamwork to fight back. One of the girls manages to outsmart the killer in a final struggle, leading to his death. They eventually get rescued and make it home, but they are forever changed by the trauma of the trip.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves teen survival horror and slasher flicks.
